title: Read the machine before touching it
summary: A practical first-look sequence for unfamiliar equipment.

blocks.title: Read the machine before touching it
blocks.body: An unfamiliar system is already telling you what matters. Slow down long enough to hear it.

items.title: Stop at the boundary
items.detail: Read labels, guards, energy sources and the work area before entering.

items.title: Ask what changed
items.detail: The last normal cycle and the first bad cycle narrow the search.

items.title: Observe one full cycle
items.detail: Watch inputs, motion, sound and operator response without intervening.

items.title: Name the first safe check
items.detail: Choose a reversible observation, not a speculative repair.

items.label: Safe boundary
items.detail: What must stay untouched or de-energized?

blocks.heading: Pick the better first move
blocks.prompt: A conveyor stopped after maintenance. The operator says the motor sounds normal.
options: Observe the safety chain and first missing permissive
blocks.explanation: Start at the first missing condition. The symptom does not yet justify changing hardware.

blocks.heading: Leave a trail
blocks.body: Write the expected state, observed state and next safe check so someone else can resume.
